title: Applause
blurb: A packed room going up: dense, overlapping clapping with no individual hands audible anywhere in it. That density is what separates heavy applause from polite applause, and it matters, because the size of the crowd you fake is the size of the joke you are making. Play it after somebody states something completely obvious and the sarcasm is instant. Play it straight over a stream milestone and it lands sincerely. Editors keep both this and a smaller version to hand for that reason — same sound, opposite meanings.
